401 Unauthorized when creating a response with invalid API key

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateResponseRequest
from liter_llm import AuthenticationError, LiterLlmError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        req = CreateResponseRequest.from_json("{\"input\":\"Hello\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\"}")
        await client.create_response(req)
    except AuthenticationError as error:
        print(f"AuthenticationError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
